name: tubesync
description: TubeSync is a PVR (personal video recorder) for YouTube. Or, like Sonarr but for YouTube (with a built-in download client). It is designed to synchronize channels and playlists from YouTube to local directories and update your media server once media is downloaded. _This is a preview release of TubeSync, it may contain bugs but should be usable._ *I am not the creator or maintainer of this container I am merely providing the Unraid template.

paths.name: Downloads
paths.description: Path to store downloaded content. Default is none.

variables.name: TubeSync Workers
variables.description: If you add a significant amount of work due to adding many large channels you may need to increase the number of background workers. Try around ~4 at most, although the absolute maximum allowed is 8. Default is 2.

variables.name: TubeSync WebUI Username
variables.description: Sets the username for HTTP basic authentication. Default is none.

variables.name: TubeSync WebUI Password
variables.description: Sets the password for HTTP basic authentication. Default is none.

variables.name: Database
variables.description: Optional external database connection details. Ex: mysql://user:pass@host:port/database. Default is none.

variables.name: Hosts
variables.description: Django's ALLOWED_HOSTS. Ex: tubesync.example.com,otherhost.com. Default is none.

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: UID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: GID for permissions. Do not change unless you know what you're doing.
